serviceCapacity.source: flexcar.service_capacities for allocatedMin, each bucket's own table for bookedMin, service_capacities reserved_minutes carried as ledgerBookedMin
serviceCapacity.note: allocatedMin is modelled labour minutes available; bookedMin comes from the bucket's authoritative table (orders=capacity_bookings Order remaining_minutes, onFlexService=maintenance_bookings total_estimated_minutes, unassignedService=unassigned_services labor_minutes); ledgerBookedMin is service_capacities reserved_minutes, which lags intermittently and is kept only so the divergence stays visible; onFlexService.bookedMin is whole-job estimated minutes while its ledgerBookedMin is remaining minutes, so those two are not expected to agree even when the ledger is healthy; null means no service_capacities row, not zero capacity

orderCapacity.note: static per-lot admin settings, not a per-day series - the same ceiling applies to every day of the window until the lot is edited in the admin UI; daily_order_capacity is the UI's 'Daily Pickup & Swap Capacity', not an all-order ceiling; null means not configured, which is not a ceiling of zero
